mapper.select: select r.warning_id, r.rule_id, r.student_id, r.subject_id, r.knowledge_id, r.paper_id, r.level, r.title, r.content, r.metric_value, r.status, r.handle_by, r.handle_time, r.handle_remark, r.create_time, s.student_name, s.student_no, wr.rule_name from spas_warning_record r left join spas_student s on s.student_id = r.student_id left join spas_warning_rule wr on wr.rule_id = r.rule_id where r.warning_id = #{warningId}
select warning_id, rule_id, student_id, status from spas_warning_record where student_id = #{studentId} and rule_id = #{ruleId} and status = '0' limit 1
select student_id from spas_warning_record where rule_id = #{ruleId} and status = '0'
select count(*) from spas_warning_record where student_id = #{studentId} and status = '0'

select r.warning_id, r.rule_id, r.student_id, r.subject_id, r.level, r.title, r.content, r.metric_value, r.status, r.create_time, wr.rule_name from spas_warning_record r left join spas_warning_rule wr on wr.rule_id = r.rule_id where r.student_id = #{studentId} and r.status = '0' order by r.create_time desc
mapper.insert: insert into spas_warning_record( rule_id, student_id, subject_id, knowledge_id, paper_id, level, title, content, metric_value, status, create_time ) values ( #{ruleId}, #{studentId}, #{subjectId}, #{knowledgeId}, #{paperId}, #{level}, #{title}, #{content}, #{metricValue}, coalesce(#{status}, '0'), now() )
